repos.name: salary-prediction-linear-regression
repos.description: A simple supervised learning project using Linear Regression to predict salary based on years of experience. Includes training script, performance metrics, and an interactive Streamlit app.

repos.name: customer-segmentation-kmeans
repos.description: An unsupervised learning project that uses K-Means clustering to segment customers based on their annual income and spending score. Includes training script, synthetic data generation, and a Streamlit visualization dashboard.

repos.name: Inventory-Management-System
repos.description: PHP and MySQL inventory system with login, products, sales, returns, stock tracking and reports.

repos.name: ai-career-recommendation-system
repos.description: AI career recommendation platform (Domain → Role → Specialization → Skill Gap → Roadmap) built with FastAPI, scikit-learn and React.

repos.name: discipline-os
repos.description: Full-stack productivity PWA: schedules, tasks, habits, workouts and goals scored daily. React + TypeScript, Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL.

repos.name: Career-Recommendation-System
repos.description: Earlier prototype of Career Navigator. See ai-career-recommendation-system for the current version.

repos.name: calculator
repos.description: The Simple Online Calculator is a web-based application that allows users to perform basic arithmetic operations quickly and efficiently. The website is built using HTML for structure, CSS for styling, and JavaScript for functionality, offering a sleek and responsive user experience.

repos.name: Zomato-Clone
repos.description: The Zomato Clone is a sleek and modern web-based application designed to replicate the look and feel of the popular Zomato platform. Built using HTML and CSS, this project demonstrates a fully responsive and visually appealing interface for discovering restaurants, browsing menus, and exploring food delivery options.

repos.name: Amazon-Clone
repos.description: The Amazon Clone is a web-based application that replicates the design and user interface of the popular Amazon shopping platform. Developed using HTML and CSS, this project showcases a fully responsive and visually appealing interface for browsing products, and making purchases.

repos.name: Instagram-Clone
repos.description: The Instagram Clone is a web-based application designed to replicate the visual appeal and user interface of the popular Instagram platform. Developed using HTML and CSS, this project showcases a sleek, responsive design that mimics Instagram’s core features, providing an immersive experience for browsing photos and connecting with others.

repos.name: coffee-shop
repos.description: Welcome to Coffee shop, your go-to online destination for discovering our cozy atmosphere, delicious coffee, and handcrafted treats. This website, built using HTML and CSS, offers a visually rich and user-friendly experience, perfectly reflecting the warmth and charm of our physical coffee shop.

repos.name: tic-tac-toe
repos.description: The Tic-Tac-Toe Game is a web-based version of the classic two-player game, brought to life using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. This simple yet engaging application allows players to enjoy the timeless game of Tic-Tac-Toe directly in their web browser, with a clean design and responsive gameplay.
